auditMetadata.auditorRole: Independent Principal Software Engineer & Buildathon Judge

verifiedInvariants: HMAC SHA-256 webhook signatures verified using crypto.timingSafeEqual (timing attack protected)
Webhook deduplication prevents duplicate event processing via database unique constraint (merchant_id, razorpay_event_id)
Authoritative 11-state machine prevents terminal state regression (RECOVERED, EXHAUSTED, ESCALATED immutable)
ACID transactions with PostgreSQL SELECT ... FOR UPDATE row-level locking prevent concurrency races
Unique constraint on (case_id, idempotency_key) in interventions table prevents duplicate charges
OUTCOME_UNKNOWN state freezes blind retries until ReconcilerWorker queries Razorpay ground truth
Zod schema validation (DiagnosisOutputSchema) isolates AI recommendations from execution
Deterministic fallback (classifyWithFallback) operates with 100% precision when AI is disabled or unreachable
6 Deterministic Policy rules override AI recommendations when constraints are violated
Counterfactual RecoveryTwinSimulator operates strictly non-executing with 0 financial permissions
Empirical batch benchmark (Mulberry32 PRNG, Seed 1337) produces reproducible 88.60% recovery rate across 10,000 cases
Multi-tenant isolation enforced in database repositories via mandatory WHERE merchant_id = $1

discoveredIssues.summary: Unauthenticated and Unscoped GET /api/v1/cases and GET /api/v1/cases/:id
discoveredIssues.rootCause: Route handlers in apps/api/src/routes/cases.ts omit requireAuth preHandler and do not filter by merchant_id, leaking cross-merchant recovery cases.

discoveredIssues.summary: Demo token mints non-UUID user ID causing approval INSERT failure
discoveredIssues.rootCause: apps/api/src/routes/auth.ts and auth.middleware.ts mint string userId ('user_admin_123') which violates UUID foreign key on approvals.user_id table.

discoveredIssues.summary: Out-of-band payment.captured webhook fails to transition from intermediate states
discoveredIssues.rootCause: ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS['DETECTED'] does not include RECOVERED; when customer pays directly downstream, webhook handler swallows transition error.

discoveredIssues.summary: Untyped NULL parameter $6 in seed.ts INSERT query
discoveredIssues.rootCause: PostgreSQL error 42P08 on untyped parameter in CASE WHEN $6 IS NOT NULL (fixed during audit).

discoveredIssues.summary: POST /api/v1/chaos/inject returns static mocks for non-outage scenarios
discoveredIssues.rootCause: Scenarios SIMULATE_TIMEOUT and REPLAY_DUPLICATE_WEBHOOK return static success messages instead of dispatching real queue events.
Repository is designed as an API, SDK, and CLI simulation engine without an active React/Next.js frontend app.
